function register(string agentURI, string[] supportedFormats, bool x402Enabled) external returns (uint256)
function requestBioAssetAccess(bytes32 bioipId, string paymentMethod) external returns (bool)
function submitPaymentProof(bytes32 bioipId, bytes32 paymentTxHash, uint256 chainId, uint256 usdcAmount) external
function convertUSDCtoBIOIP(uint256 usdcAmount) external view returns (uint256)
function giveFeedback(uint256 toAgentId, int8 value, bytes32 tag1, bytes32 tag2) external
function getAgentReputation(uint256 agentId) external view returns (int256)
function getAgent(uint256 agentId) external view returns (string agentURI, address agentWallet, bool x402Enabled, uint256 totalSpent, int256 reputationScore, bool active)
function walletToAgent(address wallet) external view returns (uint256)

function payments(uint256 paymentId) external view returns (uint256 agentId, bytes32 bioipId, bytes32 paymentTxHash, uint256 chainId, uint256 usdcAmount, uint256 bioipEquivalent, uint256 timestamp, bool verified)
event AgentRegistered(uint256 indexed agentId, address indexed wallet, string agentURI)
event AccessRequested(uint256 indexed agentId, bytes32 indexed bioipId, string paymentMethod)
event PaymentProofSubmitted(uint256 indexed paymentId, uint256 indexed agentId, bytes32 indexed bioipId)
event PaymentVerified(uint256 indexed paymentId, uint256 bioipEquivalent)
event ReputationSubmitted(uint256 indexed fromAgent, uint256 indexed toAgent, int8 value)
